mapper.sql: select e.exam_id, e.exam_name, e.exam_date, e.dept_id, e.paper_id, e.file_name, e.total_rows, e.success_rows, e.fail_rows, e.status, e.error_log, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, d.dept_name from spas_exam e left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = e.dept_id
mapper.delete: delete from spas_exam where exam_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select s.score_id, s.exam_id, s.student_id, s.score_type, s.subject_name, s.score, s.school_rank, s.create_time, s.update_time, st.student_no, st.student_name from spas_exam_score s left join spas_student st on st.student_id = s.student_id and st.del_flag = '0' where s.exam_id = #{examId} order by st.student_no asc, s.score_type asc, s.score_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into spas_exam_score(exam_id, student_id, score_type, subject_name, score, school_rank, create_time) values (#{examId}, #{studentId}, #{scoreType}, #{subjectName}, #{score}, #{schoolRank}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from spas_exam_score where exam_id = #{examId} and student_id = #{studentId}
delete from spas_exam_score where exam_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select s.score_id, s.exam_id, s.student_id, s.score_type, s.subject_name, s.score, s.school_rank, s.create_time, s.update_time, st.student_no, st.student_name, e.exam_name, e.exam_date, e.paper_id from spas_exam_score s join spas_exam e on e.exam_id = s.exam_id left join spas_student st on st.student_id = s.student_id and st.del_flag = '0' where s.student_id = #{studentId} and e.status in ('1', '2') order by e.exam_date asc nulls last, e.exam_id asc, s.score_type asc, s.score_id asc

select s.student_id, st.student_name, st.dept_id, e.exam_id, e.exam_date, s.score_type, s.subject_name, s.school_rank from spas_exam_score s join spas_exam e on e.exam_id = s.exam_id and e.status = '1' join spas_student st on st.student_id = s.student_id and st.del_flag = '0' where s.school_rank is not null order by st.student_id, e.exam_date asc nulls last, e.exam_id asc, s.score_id asc
